message.content: {"note_claim": "Blue Origin's New Glenn operations were suspended following a May 2026 explosion, with return to flight no earlier than late 2026.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Blue Origin continues to analyze the explosion of its New Glenn rocket a little more than a month ago, but on Tuesday, CEO Dave Limp shared the company's plan for resuming pad operations later this year.", "reason": "The page confirms a New Glenn explosion occurred about a month before the June 30, 2026 article (i.e., May 2026) and that Blue Origin planned to resume operations 'later this year' (late 2026), directly substantiating the note's claim."}

parsed.note_claim: Blue Origin's New Glenn operations were suspended following a May 2026 explosion, with return to flight no earlier than late 2026.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Blue Origin continues to analyze the explosion of its New Glenn rocket a little more than a month ago, but on Tuesday, CEO Dave Limp shared the company's plan for resuming pad operations later this year.
parsed.reason: The page confirms a New Glenn explosion occurred about a month before the June 30, 2026 article (i.e., May 2026) and that Blue Origin planned to resume operations 'later this year' (late 2026), directly substantiating the note's claim.
